description: Managers with a blank death_country are excluded before counting and computing shares.

c.request: For managers in `manager_award` who match a `player` record on `player_id`, count each manager's awards by their `death_country` (NULL death countries drop out), and show what share of all the awards for managers with that same death country each one accounts for. Give manager id, death country, award count and share, top 10 by share (highest first, missing last), unrounded. Managers with a blank death_country are excluded before counting and computing shares.
c.sql: SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) as share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each manager in manager_award with a non-NULL death_country from the joined player record, count their awards and calculate their share as a percentage of total awards earned by all managers in that same death_country, returning top 10 by share descending.
b.sql: SELECT ma.player_id, p.name_first, p.name_last, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country), 2) as share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country, p.name_first, p.name_last ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: For each manager in manager_award with a non-NULL death_country from the joined player record, count their awards and calculate their share as a percentage of total awards earned by all managers in that same death_country, returning top 10 by share descending.

a.request: For each manager in `manager_award` who matches a `player` record on `player_id`, count their award rows by manager and the player's `death_country`. Managers with a NULL death country drop out. Also leave out managers whose death country is an empty string, so blank death countries form no group at all. Then show each manager's award count as a share of the total awards for all managers with the same death country. List manager id, death country, award count and share, sorted by share from highest to lowest (missing last). Show the top 10, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH manager_awards_with_country AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), totals_by_country AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(award_count) as country_total FROM manager_awards_with_country GROUP BY death_country) SELECT mawc.player_id as manager_id, mawc.death_country, mawc.award_count, mawc.award_count * 1.0 / tbc.country_total as share FROM manager_awards_with_country mawc JOIN totals_by_country tbc ON mawc.death_country = tbc.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: Join manager_award with player on player_id, exclude rows where death_country is NULL, group by player_id and death_country, count awards per manager, calculate each manager's share as their award count divided by total awards for all managers in their death_country, sort by share descending, and return top 10 rows showing player_id, death_country, award count, and unrounded share.
d.sql: SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(ma.award_id) as award_count, COUNT(ma.award_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(ma.award_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) as share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
